title: Steps to Pay new single Postpaid bill payment

steps.text: Login to the mobile application, Land on accounts dashboard (account landed in the debit account number)
Click on pay bill (postpaid) , Select more than one bill from saved list  (User can select all)
Due payment amounts will be auto retrieved and the total amount for all payments will be displayed. ,  If biller allows to pay partial amount, enter amount between minimum and maximum.
Click on Pay-to-Pay payment to review details
Once all payments are saved a successful message will be displayed
